name: default-layout-lists-only-people-with-a-preparation
source: ADR 0210 default records/{account}/ layout; ADR 0520 the tab lists people who have a preparation. A record without a preparation, an empty directory and a stray file are not people with a preparation.

name: people-are-sorted-bytewise
source: Stated rule: the list is stable, ascending by account bytes, so the tab does not reorder between runs. Account spelling follows the ADR 0210 identity rule and is not case folded.

name: bodies-are-not-read
source: Stated rule: listing checks that a regular preparation file exists and never opens it, so a damaged or foreign file is still shown and can be inspected by Load, which reports the problem.

name: symlinks-are-not-people
source: ADR 0220 filesystem boundary: reject a symlink for any preparation path component. A symlinked person directory or preparation is skipped, not followed and not an error.

name: non-regular-preparations-are-not-people
source: ADR 0220 filesystem boundary: reject non-regular artifact files, including directories and special files. Listing must not block on a pipe.

name: names-that-are-not-accounts-are-skipped
source: ADR 0210 account identity rule [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* via the locator contract. Directory names outside it are not people. The valid names show the boundary characters.

name: no-records-directory-is-an-empty-list
source: ADR 0220: a new organization has no preparation yet. An absent directory is normal, not an error; the root itself must exist.

name: empty-records-directory-is-an-empty-list
source: ADR 0220: the same as no directory.

name: records-directory-as-symlink-is-refused
source: ADR 0220 filesystem boundary: reject any symlink component used for a preparation path.

name: records-as-a-file-is-refused
source: ADR 0220 filesystem boundary: a component that is not a directory cannot hold preparation.

name: custom-layout-with-prefix-and-depth
source: ADR 0210 allows a token as part of a component and deeper directories: people/person-{account}/notes/record.obk.yaml puts the preparation in the same directory as the record.

name: token-used-in-directory-and-file-name
source: ADR 0210: repeated placeholders are allowed and all are replaced. The preparation sibling name stays fixed.

name: token-repeated-in-one-component-must-match-every-time
source: ADR 0210: all tokens are replaced by the same account. Only a directory whose name is the account twice belongs to that account.

name: flat-results-path-is-refused
source: ADR 0210: a path with the account only in the filename cannot isolate a preparation; the locator rejects it and listing reports the path problem.

name: plan-without-an-id-is-refused
source: ADR 0340 and the retired guide contract: a missing plan ID cannot supply a person-specific identity.

name: plan-that-is-not-yaml-is-refused
source: ADR 0220: input artifacts must decode through the real decoder.

name: records-directory-as-a-pipe-is-refused-without-blocking
source: ADR 0220 filesystem boundary: a component that is not a directory cannot hold preparation, and a special file must never be opened for reading in a way that blocks.

name: person-directory-as-a-pipe-is-skipped-without-blocking
source: ADR 0220 filesystem boundary: a candidate that is not a directory is not a person, and listing must not block on a pipe in the place of a directory.

name: names-that-only-look-like-the-pattern-are-skipped
source: ADR 0210: the literal parts around the token must match exactly and every token reads the same account. person-ann is the only name for ann; aerson-ann and person-x differ in one literal byte, x and person- are shorter than the literal prefix person-, and person-ann-extra has a tail the pattern does not allow.

name: names-shorter-than-the-pattern-do-not-stop-the-listing
source: ADR 0210: a directory name shorter than the literal prefix cannot hold an account. It is skipped and the people after it in byte order are still listed.
